ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) covering approximately 90% of the surface, with high-intensity white speckling distributed across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous field. Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-10 pixel diameter) scattered across the interior. Concentrated white/grey mottling observed on the lateral margin of the left lobe and lower-central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression; approximate angle of 130 degrees with a central depth corresponding to roughly 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations. The left lobe trailing edge exhibits 5-7 distinct peaks with high amplitude, while the right lobe presents a more uniform, lower-amplitude jagged sequence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex arc toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular white pixel clusters (3-12 pixels wide) distributed across the central-lower ventral surface, most densely packed near the lower midline.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent diagonal white linear mark is visible on the mid-left lobe; two parallel horizontal linear marks are visible on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe appears truncated or irregularly blunted compared to the right; multiple parallel linear rake marks are visible on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Group of small dark protrusions or irregular growths visible along the extreme margin of the right distal tip.
